scores.claim_text: Next Generation Overhead Persistent Infrared (Next Gen OPIR) provides the U.S. Space Force with enhanced worldwide missile warning capabilities.
scores.M_value: Four Next-Gen OPIR PEs found: GEO (1206443SF) FUNDED_STEADY ($432M FY26, down from $691M FY24); Polar (1206444SF) UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR ($769M FY25 -> $0 FY26); Ground (1206440SF) FUNDED_SHRINKING ($500M FY25 -> $358M FY26); generic NextGen OPIR (1206442SF) FUNDED_STEADY at $190M.
scores.interpretation: LMT is the prime on Next-Gen OPIR GEO per cohort meta. GEO is FUNDED_STEADY (passes), but the Polar variant is fully zeroed in FY26 (UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR) and Ground is shrinking. The LMT narrative speaks generically about 'enhanced worldwide missile warning capabilities' without acknowledging the Polar arc is zero. Per heuristic 4 (PE name ambiguity), score the most-likely-matched PE (GEO = PASS) but flag partial divergence: the Polar segment of LMT's OPIR portfolio has been deleted. Net: MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY — the GEO line is intact but the 'worldwide' language overstates the surviving footprint.

scores.claim_text: The Transport and Tracking Layer programs comprise multiple tranches of small satellites supporting the SDA proliferated space architecture.
scores.M_value: Tranche 3 Transport Layer (PE 1206410SF): status_declared = UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS; FY25 $0 (Congress added $500M but Pentagon rejected), FY26 $0; explicit replacement_program = 'Space Data Network (SDN) Backbone / Space Link'; replacement_sole_source = 'SpaceX (Starshield)'. LMT is one of the named primary contractors on the Transport Layer. Tranche 0-2 (delivery work): status_declared FUNDED_SHRINKING (declining). Tracking Layer T3 (sda-tracking-layer-t3): FUNDED_STEADY. Earmark detector: NOT_EARMARK (regular Pentagon decision, not earmark sunset).
scores.interpretation: Concrete J-Book divergence. LMT's 10-K describes 'Transport and Tracking Layer programs' as a forward growth narrative, but the Pentagon's FY26 J-Book shows the Transport Layer Tranche 3 (the next-up tranche) has been UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS with funding redirected to a SpaceX-sole-source replacement (SDN/Starshield). Existing T0-T2 work continues but is shrinking; the Tracking Layer T3 remains funded. Per heuristic 1 (UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS -> RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE for primary-contractor revenue claims), the Tranche 3 Transport is severe — but the program is one piece of a much larger LMT portfolio, so per heuristic 2 (materiality) downgrade to SEVERE_UNDERDELIVERY: the SDA Transport pipeline LMT helped establish is being replaced by a non-LMT sole-source competitor. Heuristic 3 (reorg caveat) does NOT apply — the replacement explicitly names a different prime.

scores.claim_text: Lockheed Martin produces the Long Range Discrimination Radar (LRDR) for the Missile Defense Agency.
scores.M_value: LRDR (PE 0604873C): FY24 $100M -> FY25 $98M -> FY26 $60M (-38% YoY). status = FUNDED_SHRINKING.
scores.interpretation: LMT is the sole prime contractor for LRDR. The FY26 J-Book cuts the program 38% YoY. Per heuristic 1 (FUNDED_SHRINKING -> MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY). The 10-K lists LRDR among MDA programs but does not quantify exposure; cohort meta flags it as a named LMT program. Forward LRDR cash flow will shrink materially.
